statement: High-volume playback snapshot evidence is streamed to gzip at capture time by the recorder behind the shared owner src/diagnostics/playback-evidence-file.js, and every supported snapshot reader (failure-bundle insights, publication evidence replay, the retirement/leadership/census analyzers, admin serving in src/admin/admin-test-run-service.js, and both playback viewers) transparently accepts both legacy plain and compressed artifacts without changing replay semantics.

constraints.statement: After explicit declaration and before first execution, record an independent approving design-review receipt bound to the sealed declaration.
If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Snapshot gzip is streamed during capture, fully finalized before manifest publication, and leaves no authoritative plain sibling or partial-success manifest.
Supported readers prefer an explicitly requested existing artifact and otherwise resolve its gzip sibling, preserving legacy plain inputs, diagnostics, and replay results.
